exposure.needed: whether CA or SelfSigned issuers use RSA keys of 3072 bits or larger, and whether consuming systems support SHA-384/SHA-512

consequence.statement: Issuance still works, but certificates signed by CA/SelfSigned issuers with RSA keys of 3072 bits or larger now use SHA-384 or SHA-512; systems that do not support these hash algorithms may be affected.
consequence.remediation: Check that systems consuming these certificates support the new hash algorithms.

assertion.statement: CA and SelfSigned issuers now sign with SHA-512 for RSA keys of 4096 bits and above and SHA-384 for RSA keys of 3072 bits and above, so systems must support these hash algorithms.
